title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description_raw: FinScale is searching for a Growth Marketing Specialist with 2-3 years experience in paid acquisition, retention marketing, and funnel experimentation. The candidate will run paid ads on Meta and Google, set up event tracking in GTM/GA4, perform cohort analysis, and execute CRO tests on user signup funnels.
responsibilities: Run acquisition experiments across search, social, and referral channels.
Optimize conversion rates from app install to completed KYC.
Monitor user cohorts and report CAC and payback periods.
